map.按设定数量生成合同服务条款与报价文本样例，辅助合同初稿撰写与条款模板整理，纯前端: Generate contract service terms and quotation text samples by the set quantity, to help draft contract first versions and organize clause templates; runs in the pure front end, no data uploaded.
map.起草服务合同时批量生成条款与报价样例，作为初稿再逐条修改。: When drafting a service contract, generate clauses and quotation samples in batch as a first draft and then revise item by item.
map.给客户做报价前先生成几版不同服务项与价格的组合，供内部讨论取舍。: Before quoting a client, generate several combinations of different service items and prices for internal discussion and trade-offs.
map.整理合同模板库时，用生成的样例补充常见条款措辞。: When organizing a contract template library, use the generated samples to supplement common clause wording.
map.：设定生成数量 5，页面从内置服务项（网站开发、品牌策划、法律咨询等）中随机组合: : Set the number to generate to 5, and the page randomly combines built-in service items (website development, brand planning, legal consulting and so on) to generate quotation entries with service content, quantity and amount in Chinese capital numerals, directly as a quotation skeleton.
map.：生成数量被限制在 1–50 条之间，超出范围会按边界取值；需要更多条目可分次生: : The number to generate is limited to 1-50; values outside the range are clamped to the boundary. For more entries, generate in batches and merge.
map.生成的内容能直接当合同用吗？: Can the generated content be used directly as a contract?
map.不能。生成的是措辞样例，条款效力、金额与权责需由双方确认并经法务审核，正式合同请: No. What is generated is sample wording; the effect of the terms, the amounts and the rights and obligations must be confirmed by both parties and reviewed by legal counsel, and the formal contract is the approved version.
map.不会。生成与随机组合全部在浏览器本地完成，服务端不接收任何输入。: No. Generation and random combination all happen locally in the browser, and the server receives no input.
map.当前为随机组合生成，暂不支持锁定指定项；可先生成再从结果中挑选合适的条目手工拼接: Currently generated by random combination; locking specific items is not supported. Generate first and then pick suitable entries from the results to assemble manually.
